title: The beat launches each device's groundloop/pulse.py
owner: CC builds it; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop owns the launcher; each spawned pulse.py is owned by its own device
intention: Each beat, the ground loop launches every device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop/pulse.py as a separate process it does not wait on, and its one JSON record lists what it spawned.
why: Akien 2026-10-19: 'the post commit hook shall not call pulse. pulse shall be called from the pulse emitted by the ground loop, that IS the system deamon.' and his outline (~/.akien/20261017.CairnComponentOutlineV1.txt lines 29-30): the ground loop 'launches a script in each device's cairn/cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop called pulse.py'. Measured 2026-10-19: the loop writes liveness every 60 s and reaches nothing; ticket 164da559823d (2026-10-05) deleted the launcher and all eight pulse files, so counting_block's pulse() moved onto the post-commit hook. The charter's filed edge (b) has stood open since: 'still open: the loop spawns the pulse to its two listeners'.
traces_to: the ground_loop charter's filed edge (b) and falsifier (5) 'what it spawned' / (6) 'the loop waiting on what it spawned'; telos aim 1 (one clock, its listeners spawned, never hosted); Law 4 (one heartbeat is physics)
how: heartbeat.py gains spawn_pulses(class_root, held) -> (entries, held): glob sorted(<class_root>/cairn/devices/*/groundloop/pulse.py); first poll() every handle in held and drop the finished ones (no zombies, never blocks); then for each path Popen([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd=class_root, env=os.environ + PYTHONPATH=class_root, stdin/stdout/stderr=DEVNULL, start_new_session=True) and append {device, path, pid}; an OSError appends {device, path, error} and the next path is still spawned. __main__.py calls it once per beat and writes the entries under a new state key 'spawned' ([] on beat 0). No import of any pulse.py, no wait, no skip or overlap logic, no bus, no shim, no probe.
falsifier: Proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_beat_spawns_each_device_pulse.py runs the loop in a subprocess (cadence 0.5 s) over a scratch instance root and a scratch class root holding devices alpha (pulse.py appends its pid to a marker file), beta (pulse.py sleeps 30 s), gamma (pulse.py raises) and delta (no groundloop/pulse.py). RED if: (1) alpha's marker holds fewer than 2 pids after 3 beats; (2) the beat count does not advance past 3 within 5 s while beta sleeps (the loop waited); (3) a liveness record's 'spawned' lacks an entry for alpha, beta or gamma, or any entry lacks device+path+pid; (4) delta appears in 'spawned'; (5) gamma raising stops alpha being spawned on a later beat. The test kills the loop and every spawned pid at the end.
watchme: none, because the live effect is the next ticket's falsifier: the cairn device's groundloop/pulse.py running counting_block's pulse() on the beat is read from the live liveness record's 'spawned' key (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py writes it), and that ticket is cast after this one proves
builder_notes: Q: which proof teeth of 164da559823d change? A: test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py — tooth 1 drops its */groundloop/pulse.py assertion (beat_probes.py stays forbidden); tooth 2 drops its 'no pulse called' half and keeps 'no triggers key'; _STATE_KEYS gains 'spawned'; each change cites open-a322e5166e5d. Q: charter? A: ground_loop intention+why.json 'what' item (4) and filed edge (b) say the loop spawns each device's pulse.py; written through the artifact door. Q: interpreter? A: sys.executable. Q: which roots? A: class_root as main() already receives it (rack_ids(class_root)); None means repo_root() from discovery.py.
decisions: Launch is a detached child process per device per beat (Popen, DEVNULL, start_new_session), never an in-process import, and finished children are reaped by poll() on the next beat — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'
